messages.content: 尋找Netflix上《六人行》的電視節目列表及其評分，以及Hulu上《我們的辦公室》和《怪奇物語》的評分，並按照評分排序。

function.name: streaming_services_shows_list_and_ratings
function.description: Get a list of shows and their ratings on specific streaming services. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

streaming_service.description: Name of the streaming service. E.g., Netflix, Hulu, etc.

show_list.description: List of show names to search for on the platform.

sort_by_rating.description: If set to true, returns the list sorted by ratings. Defaults to false.

So we need to call the function streaming_services_shows_list_and_ratings with appropriate arguments.

We need to provide streaming_service: "Netflix" and show_list: ["六人行"]? But the function expects show names in English? The function description says "Name of the streaming service. E.g., Netflix, Hulu, etc." and "List of show names to search for on the platform." It doesn't specify language. We can pass Chinese names? Might be okay. But better to use English names: "Six Feet Under". For Hulu: "Our Office" and "Stranger Things".

Also sort_by_rating: true.

So we need two calls: one for Netflix with show_list ["Six Feet Under"], sort_by_rating true. Another for Hulu with show_list ["Our Office", "Stranger Things"], sort_by_rating true.

But the function signature only allows one streaming_service per call. So we need two separate calls.
